summary.text: Danielle Varda is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 27, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Eric Bodenstab (R).
She served on the Jeffco Board of Education from 2021 to 2025 and founded the health technology startup Visible Network Labs.

paragraphs.text: Danielle Varda's professional experience includes founding Visible Network Labs, a health technology startup, and working as an associate professor at the University of Colorado Denver's School of Public Affairs.
She represented District 1 on the Jeffco Board of Education from November 29, 2021 to December 3, 2025, and did not run for re-election in 2025.
